title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either rely on latent ID-based transfer with limited interpretability or directly use LLMs for sequence generation without explicitly grounding inferred semantics into position-aware predictions. To address this gap, we propose SemPOI-RL, a framework that aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation for interpretable OOT recommendation. translated_title: SemPOI-RL：对齐大语言模型语义推理以实现可解释的异地POI序列生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的语义推理和开放式生成能力，但将这些能力与结构化序列生成进行对齐仍然具有挑战性。这一挑战在异地（OOT）POI序列生成中尤为突出，模型需要从用户的家乡行为中推断可迁移的旅行意图，适应跨城市的兴趣漂移，并在结构约束下生成连贯的目的地轨迹。现有方法要么依赖于可解释性有限的潜在ID迁移，要么直接使用LLM进行序列生成，而没有将推断出的语义明确地落地到位置感知的预测中。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了SemPOI-RL，这是一个将LLM语义推理与结构化序列生成对齐的框架，用于实现可解释的异地推荐。具体而言，我们首先微调LLM，使其能够从用户的家乡行为中推断面向目的地的旅行风格（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SemPOI-RL框架，通过将大语言模型的语义推理能力与结构化序列生成对齐，从用户家乡行为中推断可迁移的旅行意图并适应跨城兴趣漂移，从而实现可解释的异地POI序列推荐。
en_tdlr: SemPOI-RL aligns LLM semantic reasoning with structured sequence generation to infer transferable travel intent from hometown behaviors and deliver interpretable out-of-town POI sequential recommendations.
